earnings.title: Contact: Franklin Templeton, Inc.
highlights: Preliminary net income 1 for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026 was $1,075.3 million or $1.97 per diluted share, as compared to $524.9 million or $0.91 per diluted share for the prior fiscal year.

Preliminary operating income was $355.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to operating income of $215.8 million for the previous quarter and $85.4 million for the prior year.

Preliminary adjusted net income 2 was $493.4 million and preliminary adjusted diluted earnings per share 2 was $0.94 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $386.3 million and $0.72 for the previous quarter, and $357.5 million and $0.67 for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

Preliminary adjusted net income 2 was $1,642.6 million and preliminary adjusted diluted earnings per share 2 was $3.07 for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $1,195.8 million and $2.22 for the prior fiscal year.
Preliminary adjusted operating income 2 was $598.6 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $508.9 million for the previous quarter and $472.4 million for the prior year.

quotes.text: Franklin Templeton delivered strong fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 results, reflecting the momentum across our business and continued execution of our strategy.
quotes.by: Jenny Johnson, Chief Executive Officer of Franklin Templeton, Inc

items.heading: Volatility and disruption of our business and financial markets and adverse changes in the global economy may significantly affect our results of operations and put pressure on our financial results.
Our funds may be subject to liquidity risks or unanticipated large numbers of redemptions and fund closures.
Poor investment performance of our products could reduce the level of our AUM or affect our sales, and negatively impact our revenues and income.
Harm to our reputation may negatively impact our revenues and income.
Our business and operations are subject to adverse effects from the outbreak and spread of contagious diseases.
We may review and pursue strategic transactions that could pose risks to our business and global operations.
